title: Flowers, Pollination and Fertilisation
summary: The parts of a flower, self- and cross-pollination, the helpers that carry pollen, and how seeds and fruits form.

ib.note: Double fertilisation is studied in DP

cbse.chapter: Earlier NCERT Ch 12: Reproduction in Plants

objectives: I can identify the male and female parts of a flower and their functions.
I can explain self-pollination and cross-pollination and the agents that carry pollen.
I can describe how fertilisation leads to seeds and fruits.
misconceptions: All flowers are pollinated by bees.
Pollination and fertilisation are the same.
The whole flower becomes the fruit.
